title: WorkPulse interview.completed v1
description: The assigned interviewer filed feedback, completing the interview. Identifiers and the acting user only — the rating and feedback notes are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

candidate_id.description: The candidate being interviewed (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012 — candidate fallback orders interviews with their candidate).

job_id.description: The job the candidate applied to (UUIDv7 string).

interviewer_id.description: Employee id of the assigned interviewer (UUIDv7 string; a person, not a user account).

completed_by.description: Actor user id that filed the feedback — the assigned interviewer (ADR 0010).
